description: Seaport 1.6 cross-stack vectors. Struct hashes asserted equal to Seaport.getOrderHash() and every non-padding signature accepted by Seaport.validate(), both via read-only eth_call when this file was written. Wire encoding per the interface contract: uint256 as decimal strings, itemType/orderType/totalOriginalConsiderationItems as integers, lowercase hex.
notes: erc721: Otherdeed Expanded #1, 1 ETH total, fee 1% to the mainnet fee recipient, royalty 5% to 0x...dead, counter 0, salt OSWI + 28 x 0x11, signed under the chain 1 domain; apechain = the same struct signed under the 33139 domain.
erc1155: the erc721 order with an ERC-1155 offer of 5 units and orderType 1 (PARTIAL_OPEN); consideration unchanged (1 ETH total, every amount divisible by 5).

bulk: orders differing only in identifierOrCriteria 1..n with n = 2, 3, 5 (heights 1, 2, 3); heights 2 and 3 are padded with the blank OrderComponents (all zero, empty arrays). Every leaf, padding included, carries signature || uint24 index || proof.
signatureEip2098: the erc721 signature in 64-byte compact form.

Release 2 (Seaport offers). Signer = anvil key #0 (signer above), counter 0, orderType 0 (FULL_OPEN), zone/zoneHash 0, conduitKey 0 (the bidder approves Seaport itself), times 1767225600 -> 1798761600, salt OSWI + 28 x 0x22.

offerErc721: offer WETH 1e18; consideration [ERC721 Otherdeed Expanded #1 -> offerer, WETH 1e16 -> mainnet fee recipient, WETH 5e16 -> 0x...dead]. apechain (on every offer kind) = the same struct with WAPE and the fee to the ApeChain splitter, signed under the 33139 domain.
offerErc1155: offerErc721 with consideration[0] itemType 3 (amount 1); basicOrderType 20. offerCollection: consideration[0] = {4 (ERC721_WITH_CRITERIA), Otherdeed Expanded, 0, 1, 1}.

basicOrderParameters / acceptCollection: the accept payload in the /bids/accept-data wire encoding; calldata = the ABI-encoded call (what the backend builds); sentCalldata = the exact bytes the frontend sends, the same call followed by the 4-byte OSWiki domain tag 0xda32920a. Counts and indices (totalOriginalAdditionalRecipients, numerator, denominator, resolver and fulfillment indices) are JSON integers.

acceptCollection: matchAdvancedOrders for offerCollection, tokenId 42, fulfiller anvil #1; mirror (unsigned) times 1767225600 -> 1767227400, salt OSWI + 28 x 0x33, conduitKey = OpenSea; mirrorOrderHash is its struct hash with counter 0, for reference only.
offerCollectionBulk: height 1, leaf 0 = offerCollection, leaf 1 = the same with the last salt byte 0x23; every leaf signature = rootSignature || uint24 index || proof.

Every struct hash was asserted equal to Seaport.getOrderHash() and every signature accepted by Seaport.validate() (eth_call on the order chain) when this block was written; the mirror was hash-checked only.
